name: Macpower CNC Machines Limited
summary: Macpower CNC Machines Limited manufactures and sells computer numerical control (CNC) metal cutting machines in India. It offers CNC turning centers for the bearing, valve, pump, tool room, automobile, process plant components, agriculture, textile, and piping industries; and vertical machining centers (VMCs) for tool rooms, die and moulds, automobile, pattern, defence, power, and railways. The company also provides turn mill centers for special purpose components, aeronautics, defence, agriculture, and medical applications; and vertical turret lathe for valve and motor bodies, engine liners, and railways.
